answer: Reward claims carry behavioral telemetry, so resist sybils by fingerprinting arrival patterns instead of trusting identities. A sable swarm of fake agents tends to synchronize: identical client fingerprints, lockstep inter-arrival timing, and geometric clock skew, while genuine agents show natural jitter and diverse device signatures. Flagging clusters whose arrival plume is too regular and linking them to one operator turns the network into a haven for honest participants — each payoff becomes evidence, not just a number.
